lead: Ramoji Rao was an Indian entrepreneur, born on 16 November 1936 in Pedaparupudi.
He died on 8 June 2024 in Hyderabad at the age of 87.
He has 29 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Filmfare Awards South and Padma Vibhushan in literature & education.
This profile collects the Ramoji facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
